violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Boxes food being stored on the floor in the freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Inside of the ice machine and the vents need to be cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelves holding the cleaning chemicals and the shelving in the walk-in cooler need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Employee observed washing hands in a warewash sink. Observed employee wash their hands in the 3 compartment sink.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors throughout the facility need to be cleaned.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. Fly strips were hung by the dry board of thee compartment sink, and a prep table.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Several towels left in the prep area and on the cooking line, not in sanitizer between uses.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Oven cooking bacon not underneath the hood system.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pans used on the bottom shelf of the prep table were not being changed out and had excess debris build up.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single use items on the cooking line should be inverted.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. The freezer floor has deteriorated and is no longer a clean-able surface. Floors underneath the equipment on the cooking line need to be cleaned.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mops in the back by the office were wet and stored on the floor, not allowing them to dry properly.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Chemical spray bottle and glass cleaner stored alongside single-use items in front counter area.
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Thermometers provided, used, clean, and accurate (1 pt deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
